description: This is a shell script used for self-healing network connectivity, including functions for resetting the router, performing ping and DNS ping tests, and executing corrective actions based on network responses.

methods.name: getCorrectiveActionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of corrective actions from system configuration.

methods.name: calcRandTimetoStartPing
methods.description: Calculates a random delay time before starting the ping test to distribute load.

methods.name: resetRouter
methods.description: Reboots the router by invoking the device control simulation command.

methods.name: resetNeeded
methods.description: Checks process name and triggers router reset if process is 'PING'.

methods.name: runDNSPingTest
methods.description: Performs DNS resolution test and takes corrective action if DNS resolution fails.

methods.name: runPingTest
methods.description: Performs ping tests to the default gateway and executes corrective actions on failure.
